description: UAT execution; synced with API + browser evidence.

rows.scenario_title: New customer registers and can log out and log back in
rows.actual_result: Register/login verified via pytest (register/login/me); UI logout/login spot-check recommended before final demo.

rows.scenario_title: Customer browses catalog, opens a product, and confirms price/stock display is usable
rows.actual_result: Catalog and search exercised in browser smoke; product detail route available from listing.

rows.scenario_title: Customer adds items, updates quantities, removes an item, completes checkout
rows.actual_result: Cart + guest-checkout guard in browser; authenticated checkout path in pytest.

rows.scenario_title: Customer views order history and sees status for a placed order
rows.actual_result: Customer order list behavior covered by pytest GET /api/orders/me after checkout.

rows.scenario_title: Staff admin adds a new product, edits it, verifies it appears to customers
rows.actual_result: Admin product CRUD exercised in pytest (POST/PATCH/DELETE /api/products).

rows.scenario_title: Staff admin updates an order status and customer sees the update
rows.actual_result: Admin order status PATCH verified in pytest; customer UI refresh expected to reflect API state.

rows.scenario_title: Guest and customer cannot access admin routes; admin cannot be treated as customer-only restricted endpoints incorrectly
rows.actual_result: Guest checkout redirect in browser; 401/403 RBAC cases in pytest.
